tvShow.name: The Night Agent
tvShow.overview: Brought together by a midnight phone call, an FBI agent and a cybersecurity expert must unravel an ever-growing web of political conspiracies.

episodes.name: The Call
episodes.overview: While working the night action desk, FBI agent Peter receives a distress call and is soon put in charge of protecting cybersecurity expert Rose.

episodes.name: Redial
episodes.overview: After looking for a link between the Campbells and the FBI, Peter is forced to go on the run with Rose in search of a hard drive — and more answers.

episodes.name: The Zookeeper
episodes.overview: Peter teams up with Rose for a risky mission at the White House. Elsewhere, a notable agent joins the security detail for the vice president's daughter.

episodes.name: Eyes Only
episodes.overview: Rose and Peter seek out one of the Campbells' recent contacts and uncover new intel. Monks opens up to Chelsea. Paulo makes a move on Maddie.

episodes.name: The Marionette
episodes.overview: Peter visits someone close to Hawkins. Rose makes a key connection. Maddie’s night out takes a dangerous turn, spurring the Secret Service into action.

episodes.name: Fathoms
episodes.overview: With assassins hot on their trail, Peter and Rose split up en route to the White House. A shocking discovery quickly puts their lives in jeopardy.

episodes.name: Best Served Cold
episodes.overview: Now in hiding, Peter and Rose grow closer and investigate a potential bombing suspect. At the White House, the conspirators obtain a disturbing tape.

episodes.name: Redux
episodes.overview: More truths emerge about the bombing suspect's identity. Chelsea and Peter race to find Maddie after she sends a video with a coded message.

episodes.name: The Devil We Know
episodes.overview: After new revelations surface, Peter and Rose scramble to find more evidence with help from Chelsea and Maddie. A bigger threat looms at Camp David.

episodes.name: Fathers
episodes.overview: With lives at stake, the group tries to stop a nefarious plot before it's too late. In the aftermath, Peter confronts the past and begins a new chapter.

episodes.name: Call Tracking
episodes.overview: After a disastrous mission in Bangkok, Peter goes AWOL to track an American agent accused of leaking secrets. Meanwhile, Rose receives a disturbing call.

episodes.name: Disconnected
episodes.overview: Reunited at last, Peter and Rose race to intercept Warren. Noor weighs using her access to classified Iranian intelligence for her own gain.

episodes.name: Government Property
episodes.overview: Catherine aids Peter's off-the-books investigation into Foxglove while Noor stumbles upon an unexpected encounter. A hijacking spirals out of control.

episodes.name: Desperate Measures
episodes.overview: Peter and Rose infiltrate a party at the Iranian ambassador's home, arousing Javad's suspicion. Tomás and Markus lock horns over the Foxglove plan.

episodes.name: A Family Matter
episodes.overview: Eager for intel about Night Action, Jacob makes Solomon a lucrative offer. Javad senses a traitor in his midst. Sami undertakes a covert mission in Iran.

episodes.name: A Good Agent
episodes.overview: Rose grapples with a crisis of conscience. Viktor reveals his true goal to Tomás, and the hunter becomes the hunted when Solomon's team stalks Peter.

episodes.name: Tilt
episodes.overview: Peter plays hardball to force Solomon to talk. Following a lead, Rose seeks answers from a Foxglove scientist — but finds herself in a lethal situation.

episodes.name: Divergence
episodes.overview: Desperate to locate Rose, Peter makes a game-changing deal with Jacob. Tomás discovers just how far Markus is willing to go in service to his father.

episodes.name: Cultural Exchange
episodes.overview: Breaching one of the most high-security locations in New York puts Peter's skills to the test. Rose and Dr. Cole enact a daring plan to stop Markus.

episodes.name: Buyer's Remorse
episodes.overview: With time running out, Peter and Rose scramble to prevent a mass casualty event. Catherine floats an intriguing proposal.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: The hunt for a CIA agent accused of leaking secrets puts Peter and Rose in the crosshairs of a ruthless intelligence broker and a deadly war criminal.

episodes.name: Call Waiting
episodes.overview: A deadly attack ignites a crisis within the White House. In Istanbul, Peter pursues a fugitive who's stolen classified files.

episodes.name: Package Deal
episodes.overview: Peter considers a deal with the devil. Isabel follows a suspicious document trail down the rabbit hole. Night Action gets a harsh lesson in compliance.

episodes.name: Dark Matters
episodes.overview: Peter brings POTUS up to speed after a sting operation. A lethal cat-and-mouse game unfolds at the home of a reluctant source.

episodes.name: Orion
episodes.overview: Peter's visit to an exclusive hunting lodge turns into a fight for survival. Chelsea's concerns grow when a White House statement doesn't add up.

episodes.name: The Isolation Play
episodes.overview: Every second counts as Peter and Adam infiltrate a casino on a high-stakes mission. Jay finds clues to the next strike hidden in a crypto wallet.

episodes.name: Murky Waters
episodes.overview: Chelsea's off-the-books probe worries her closest ally. Peter and Isabel's rescue plan spirals out of control when the Father joins the fray.

episodes.name: Once Upon a Time...
episodes.overview: An American legal consultant in Mexico finds himself caught in an impossible bind. Years later, he's trapped once again — and Peter is his only hope.

episodes.name: Truth Be Told
episodes.overview: An enigmatic opponent pushes Peter to his limits in a ruthless mind game. Jacob uses his vast database of secrets as a bargaining chip.

episodes.name: Lockstep
episodes.overview: With his Cabinet urging swift retaliation, POTUS weighs his options. Isabel and Jay scramble to crack Jacob's code. Peter's day takes an explosive turn.

episodes.name: Razzmatazz
episodes.overview: On their own, on the run and out of time, Peter and Isabel put their lives on the line to expose the conspiracy — before it silences them for good.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Coming off the explosive events of Season Two, Night Agent Peter Sutherland is called in to track down a young Treasury Agent who fled to Istanbul with sensitive government intel after killing his boss. This kicks off a sequence of events where Peter investigates a dark money network while avoiding its paid assassins, while putting him on a collision course with a relentless journalist. Working together, they uncover buried secrets and old grudges that threaten to bring the government to its knees -- and get them both killed in the process.

reviews.author: Sam
reviews.content: Another Netflix show with mediocre writing filled with cliches. It started off well but slumped in the middle. Had to reach episode 8 to pick up some pace. They should have reduced the episodes to 6 making it more fast paced rather than dragging it on. Another problem there was no chemistry between the characters and the villains were just caricatures. Watch it if you have nothing else to watch and want to numb yourself from boredom.

reviews.author: Dean
reviews.content: Good show. It's interesting and characters are well developed. Acting also good. No propaganda as well.
